This API lists the duplicate entries of a contact.The _fieldName_ parameters is mandatory in the API request

_Note:_
If you encounter a 202 status code while executing this API request, it means there are 100,000 or more contacts in the help desk portal. Matching the records and finding duplicates will be time-consuming in such a scenario.
